title: Derivative of a sign encoding
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x,y$ be points of that cube. The product of the real sign encodings of $f(x+y)$ and $f(x)$ equals the real sign encoding of the Boolean derivative $f(x)+f(x+y)$ at $x$.
